# Power Grab TX

> Power Grab TX tracks the real cost of the AI data center boom in Texas — on
> the power grid, the water table, and the communities living in its shadow.
> Independent, reader-supported reporting and data tracking, not affiliated
> with any data center developer, utility, or government agency.

Power Grab TX publishes original reporting, a running news tracker, and a
plain-language glossary covering AI data center construction, ERCOT grid
strain, water use, tax incentives, and community impact across Texas.

## Reporting

- [Posts](https://powergrabtx.com/posts/): Original articles and analysis on Texas AI data centers.
- [Latest News](https://powergrabtx.com/news/): Continuously updated aggregation of Texas AI data center news.
- [AI Data Center Tracker](https://powergrabtx.com/trackers/): A dated, sourced log of developments with editorial commentary.
- [Right Now](https://powergrabtx.com/right-now/): A snapshot of what's currently happening across the state.
- [Morning Briefing](https://powergrabtx.com/briefings/): Daily briefings on Texas & DFW AI data center, grid, and land-use news.

## Reference

- [AI Data Center Glossary](https://powergrabtx.com/glossary/): Plain-language definitions of AI data center and grid terminology.
- [About](https://powergrabtx.com/about/): Who publishes Power Grab TX and why.

## Community

- [Community Blog](https://powergrabtx.com/blog/): Reader-submitted stories, reviewed before publication.
- [Stay Informed](https://powergrabtx.com/stay-informed/): Subscribe to updates or contact Power Grab TX directly.
